description: She wears an opaque burgundy floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, patterned shoulder straps fixed by small oval brooches, elbow-length outer sleeves over cream linen sleeves and broad gold-brown woven borders at neckline, waist, cuffs and hem. A cream bordered shoulder wrap rests along her forearms and hangs down both sides. A cream underskirt appears through the modest opening below the knee; a brown closed shoe is visible beneath the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon; substantial opaque fabric covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis.
